scope: Client startup identity, version aliases and explicit ambient session setup

implementationChecks.command: pnpm exec vitest run test/client-package.test.ts test/cli-setup.test.ts test/cli.test.ts
implementationChecks.note: Focused suites passed before the final OpenCode filename and additional failure-case changes; the final package suite was rerun below.
Builds dist/npm, packs and installs the tarball offline into an empty prefix, then executes its installed client and generated host integrations with isolated configuration.

verifiedBehaviors: --version, -v and -V each emit the bare client version and exit 0 without configuration or host writes
Home identifies the executable and client before missing configuration, refused authentication and unavailable connectivity diagnostics without session data
A clean offline npm installation signs in against a fake and discovers tools using saved connection settings
Claude Code and Codex SessionStart commands execute current minimal tool context
The OpenCode 1.19.x local JavaScript plugin appends fresh context through its published system transform interface
Explicit setup preserves unrelated settings, repeats without writes, repairs relocated paths and refuses unmanaged or edited plugins without force
PATH selection uses the first executable and falls back to the installed client when another binary shadows it
Discovery preserves host files; authentication and installation failures preserve existing files
Ambient context reflects removed grants and explicitly reports authentication, connectivity and missing-executable failures without cached grants
limitations: Host contract tests execute installed commands and plugin exports without a live model session; host trust approval remains user-controlled
Hook installation is supported on Linux; Pi and other platforms retain skill-only setup
OpenCode support is bounded to its released 1.19.x plugin interface
The required container acceptance is unverified under the offline-only constraint: its fresh private BuildKit cache downloads pinned build dependencies
The private hygiene deny list is intentionally unavailable to this worker; private hygiene acceptance is unverified
